intent: Lean PR CI without weakening the merge membrane: per-job skip (SKIPPED, not MISSING) for CodeQL, Semgrep, and quality-ratchet on irrelevant diffs; hermetic uv install for required pytest. Do not drop pytest 3.11/3.12 from pull_request or path-filter required workflows.

gates.name: classifier-and-path-filter-contracts
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_classify_changed_paths.py tests/test_workflow_path_filters.py tests/test_bootstrap_contract.py tests/test_polyglot_ci_contract.py

negative_controls.name: docs-only-must-not-mark-analysis-classes
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts/ci'); import classify_changed_paths as c; d=c.classify(['docs/architecture/NAVIGATION.md']); assert d.get('codeql') is False and d.get('semgrep') is False and d.get('quality_ratchet') is False, d"

commit.message: ci: skip inapplicable advisory scans per-job; hermetic uv pytest install

honest_blockers: pytest 3.11 and 3.12 remain required pull_request contexts; dropping either without a simultaneous branch-protection edit would wedge merge (tests/test_workflow_path_filters.py).
Workflow-level paths: filters are still forbidden on contracted check names; this packet uses per-job SKIPPED instead.
Local packet gates cannot prove GitHub queue-depth reduction; that is a post-merge observation on live PRs.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the commits on ci/lean-pr-membrane-20260820. Required pytest contexts, branch protection, and advisory contracted names are unchanged in identity; only install path and per-job skip conditions revert.
